source.title: Call for Applicants - WCAT Members (June 2024)
source.content:
The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) is seeking new members! The application is open to any WCA community member, but please review the expected tasks and qualities.

The official rights and duties of the WCAT are documented in WCA Motion [10.2021.2](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf).

**The tasks of a WCAT member include:**

* Review and announce competitions around the world on a daily basis with accuracy and correctness.
* Handle change requests to competitions.
* Engage in frequent discussions through voting within the Team.
* Make and communicate changes to the WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP).
<!-- break -->
**Applicants are expected to possess the following qualities:**

* Proactive personality, detail-oriented, and solution-oriented mindset.
* Fluency in English.
* Availability throughout the day and to commit 5 hours per week to WCAT work.
* Good familiarity with the [WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP)](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf) and the WCA competition organizer role.
* Communication and/or policy-writing skills are not required but are strongly encouraged.
* Be at least 16 years of age.

**Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

* A brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* A concrete overview on how expected qualities are to be fulfilled.
* (Optional) Qualities and qualifications you find relevant that are not listed above.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until **July 8th, 2024 23:59 UTC** to Zeke Mackay (zmackay@worldcubeassociation.org).

translation.title: WCA 比赛公告团队招募成员（2024 年 6 月）
translation.content:
WCA 比赛公告团队（WCAT）正在招募新成员！所有 WCA 社区成员均可申请，请先了解以下工作内容和要求。

WCAT 的正式权利与职责见 WCA [10.2021.2 号议案](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf)。

**WCAT 成员的工作包括：**

* 每天准确审核并公布世界各地的比赛。
* 处理比赛信息变更申请。
* 经常参与团队内部讨论和投票。
* 修订并传达 WCA 比赛要求政策（WCRP）的变更。
<!-- break -->
**我们希望申请人具备：**

* 积极主动、注重细节，善于解决问题。
* 英语流利。
* 每天能够分时段参与，每周投入 5 小时处理 WCAT 工作。
* 熟悉 [WCA 比赛要求政策（WCRP）](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf)及比赛组织者的职责。
* 沟通或政策撰写能力并非硬性要求，但十分有帮助。
* 年满 16 岁。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：**

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
* 具体说明自己如何满足上述要求。
* （选填）其他你认为与岗位有关的素质和资历。

申请从即日起开放，请于 **2024 年 7 月 8 日 23:59 UTC** 前将材料发送给 Zeke Mackay（zmackay@worldcubeassociation.org）。
